rv.q: The cast of 16 under the direction of Nate Cohen (Paramount debut) will leave you breathless, laughing and a little teary eyed. That is what makes good art.
Paramount's devilishly creative, laugh-out-loud hilarious and marvelously magical production is a sweet summertime surprise.

And this Nate Cohen-directed production wrings every bit of goofy fun possible from the script, making this one of the most entertaining theatre evenings you'll find anywhere. The Peter Pan story is, of course, well-known, but Peter and the Starcatcher focuses on how its many unusual elements came together in the first place.
Kudos to Cohen, his talented cast and his resourceful designers for a winning revival that reminds us of the joy of a good story, well-told.

Full of stunning performances and remarkable stage magic, Peter and the Starcatcher will leave you on the edge of your seat – eager for what's next and wishing there was more beyond the final lights down.
Tonight's production at The Copley Theatre was just right!
